diag.title: Send a diagnostic report?
diag.intro: This is exactly what would leave this computer. People, addresses and chats are already numbers; the words of your mails and messages are never included. You can shorten the text; nothing is sent until you click Send.
diag.freeTextDropped: Your question's words were left out: your model runs in a cloud, so no local model could check it for names.
diag.question: Your question, as it would be sent (shorten it if you like)
diag.note: What went wrong, in your words (optional)
diag.notePlaceholder: e.g. it showed last month's order, not the newest
diag.sentText: Thank you. The report is queued and leaves with the next send; you can see it under Settings → Developer → Diagnostics.
